aspect: The same number, used both ways
description: That young men are overwhelmingly the victims is also used as grounds to treat young men as the threat. He is inside the statistic in both directions at once.
energy_note: The number that describes his danger describes him as dangerous.

description: A truck, a cap, visible ink and being out late constitute reasonable suspicion in practice if not in law, which makes ordinary young-man behaviour into a profile.
energy_note: Suspicious for being twenty-four and outdoors.

aspect: He adapts his own life pre-emptively
description: Routes changed, hours shortened, clothing chosen for how it reads, phone kept visible - a continuous unpaid management of other people's suspicion.
energy_note: Dressing every morning for a police officer.

description: There is a direct road home that takes eleven minutes. He takes the one that takes twenty-six, because the direct one passes two places where young men get stopped. He has done this every night for three years and has never once described it as fear.
energy_note: Fifteen extra minutes, nightly, that he does not call fear.
